extraction.name: PASTIS
extraction.description: Panoptic Agricultural Satellite TIme-Series (PASTIS), the first open-access SITS dataset with panoptic annotations, comprising 2,433 sequences of multi-spectral images covering over 4000 km2 in France.
extraction.creator: Vivien Sainte Fare Gamot, Loic Landrieu
extraction.publisher: LASTIG, Univ. Gustave Eiffel, ENSG, IGN
extraction.citeAs: Vivien Sainte Fare Gamot and Loic Landrieu. Panoptic Segmentation of Satellite Image Time Series with Convolutional Temporal Attention Networks. ICCV, 2021.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset consists of satellite image time series obtained from the open-access Sentinel-2 platform. The images were processed by THEIA (CNES) using Copernicus data. Annotations were retrieved from the publicly available French Land Parcel Identification System (FLPIS).
extraction.rai:dataCollectionMissingData: The dataset contains irregular temporal sampling due to automatic filtering of acquisitions with extensive cloud cover by the satellite data provider THEIA. Approximately 28% of images have at least partial cloud cover. No further pre-processing or cloud detection was applied to the raw data.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Sentinel-2 satellite imagery (10 spectral bands, 10m resolution) and French Land Parcel Identification System (FLPIS) data.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Sentinel-2 tiles were subdivided into 128x128 pixel patches. Parcels were cropped to patch extents. Parcels with more than 50% surface outside the patch or with crop types not in the 18-class nomenclature were annotated with a 'void' label and excluded from metrics. The dataset was split into 5 folds with a 1km buffer to avoid cross-fold contamination.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Atmospheric correction and re-sampling to 10 meters per pixel were performed by THEIA. Atmospheric bands (B01, B09, B10) were removed. Sequences were stacked to form 4D tensors. Patches were selected favoring rare crop types to decrease class imbalance.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Each pixel is associated with a semantic label (18 crop types + background) and a unique instance label (parcel index). Annotations include bounding boxes, pixel-precise masks, and crop types. Annotations are taken from the French Land Parcel Identification System (FLPIS). The French Payment Agency estimates annotation accuracy via in situ control over 98%.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: The dataset is highly unbalanced, with a ratio of over 50 between the most and least common classes. Parcels belonging to classes not in the 18-class nomenclature or with insufficient overlap with patches are labeled as 'void' and ignored in metrics.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset supports crop mapping, which has major financial and environmental stakes, including fair allocation of agricultural subsidies and ensuring best crop rotation practices. It also aids in surveying urban development and deforestation.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The dataset is highly unbalanced regarding crop types. The selection of patches favored those with rare crop types to decrease class imbalance. The data covers only four regions of France.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The dataset covers only 1% of the French Metropolitan territory. It suffers from irregular temporal sampling and cloud cover. The 'void' label is used for out-of-scope parcels. The panoptic metrics do not include the background class.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training, Testing, Validation, Fine Tuning of panoptic segmentation and semantic segmentation models for Satellite Image Time Series (SITS).
